request.style: English, soul, male solo voice with gospel choir, acoustic piano, organ, cello, drums, mournful and triumphant, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He looked at the disciple by his side
Here is your mother, he said with pride
From that hour she entered his home
No more alone, in Jesus' name

[Verse]
Knowing all things were now complete
Scripture fulfilled on this holy street
He said I thirst, dry lips and tongue
A jar of sour wine stood along

[Chorus]
Soaked a sponge in the bitter wine
Held it high on a hyssop line
To his mouth they raised the branch
He received the drink to his command

[Verse]
When he had taken the final cup
He spoke the words, making all stop
It is finished, the debt is paid
Bowing his head, the spirit stayed

[Chorus]
Soaked a sponge in the bitter wine
Held it high on a hyssop line
To his mouth they raised the branch
He received the drink to his command

[Verse]
The day of preparation was near
Jews did not want bodies here
For that Sabbath was a high day
Ask Pilate to stop the display

[Chorus]
Soaked a sponge in the bitter wine
Held it high on a hyssop line
To his mouth they raised the branch
He received the drink to his command

[Bridge]
Soldiers broke legs of men beside
But came to Jesus, dead with pride
They saw he was already gone
Did not break his legs, the work was done

[Outro]
It is finished, the story ends
Bowing his head, to his Father he bends
